Sets the playback frequency that channels of this sound start with, in hertz. Channels that are already playing keep theirs: use [ChannelPitch](ChannelPitch) for those.

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
SoundPitch snd, 44100
PlaySound snd
Delay 400
SoundPitch snd, 11025
PlaySound snd
Delay 1000
```
@param sound  A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound).
@param hertz  The frequency to play at. A value equal to the frequency of the file plays it normally.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
